scripts.seed: node seed/build-seed.js && wrangler d1 execute optimart-db --local --file seed/seed.sql && node seed/upload-r2.js
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply optimart-db --remote
scripts.seed:remote: node seed/build-seed.js && wrangler d1 execute optimart-db --remote --file seed/seed.sql && node seed/upload-r2.js --remote
